decision: Deliver a generic architecture proposal with explicit untested guarantees
why: The user requested a design; no repository or running system was supplied

decision: Use three read-only reviewers for lifecycle, external actions, and product tradeoffs
why: Parent owns fan-out: the parent alone assigns work and edits the shared design

decision: Compare persistent machines, stateless workers, and durable tasks with replaceable workspaces
why: Exhaust the design space: materially different designs expose where complexity goes

decision: Make the durable task the authority and machine suspension an optimization
why: Redesign from first principles: task continuity must survive machine replacement

decision: Name task, attempt, checkpoint, candidate, operation, and acceptance records
why: Named shape: ownership and invariants come before component selection

decision: Separate writable workspaces and give shared publication one integration owner
why: Separate before serializing: parallel attempts should not share mutable working state

decision: Persist operation identity and outcome; reconcile ambiguous external writes
why: Make operations idempotent: retries need destination support and must not invent certainty

decision: Start with one control application and one execution backend
why: Smallest change: logical boundaries do not all need separate deployed services

decision: Limit first recovery contract to repository files, task records, and receipts
why: Smallest change: application-consistent backup of arbitrary services is a separate capability

decision: Add bounded draining, checkpoint sequence checks, and exclusive workspace transfer
why: Lifecycle review found stale workers and out-of-order uploads could violate ownership

decision: Allow only the verification controller to attest required checks
why: External-action review found worker uploads could impersonate trusted evidence

decision: Authorize the exact integrated candidate and expected destination revision
why: External-action and lifecycle reviews found approval could otherwise carry onto changed contents

decision: Keep old worker budget reserved until charges can no longer accrue
why: Lease expiry does not prove infrastructure termination

decision: Show a concrete return screen, keep review independent of compute, and limit automatic unfinished work
why: Experience first: the consumer must be able to return and decide without creating hidden compute or review debt

decision: Specify failure tests and measurement plan without claiming runtime proof
why: Prove on the artifact: document review cannot establish execution guarantees or performance

decision: Review the final document and all decision evidence pointers
why: Reviewed by parent. Attention: implementation, fault injection, security boundaries, and performance remain untested

decision: Extend the architecture with a design for one model and serial tool execution
why: Smallest change: establish a useful recoverable loop before adding orchestration

decision: Start with one supervised command tool and typed terminal reports
why: Compared command-only, structured tool sets, and a general workflow framework

decision: Keep the harness outside writable code and reuse controller authority
why: One home: the harness must not create a second scheduler or permission system

decision: Commit matching file and conversation references after each command
why: Named shape: a continuation must describe one consistent point of progress

decision: Validate complete model responses and reject unknown or malformed actions
why: Boundary discipline: streamed fragments and unvalidated model text cannot authorize execution

decision: Keep stable calls and external operation references across restarts
why: Make operations idempotent: a restarted model loop must not silently create another logical operation

decision: Close turns and record proposals once under current revision and epoch
why: Review found an empty reply could stall the loop and a restart could duplicate a handoff

decision: Close superseded batches with honest per-call observations
why: Review found abandoned call IDs could create an invalid or misleading model continuation

decision: Specify real interruption tests and retain explicit runtime unknowns
why: Prove on the artifact: design review is not proof of a running harness

decision: Check the revised document and all decision evidence pointers
why: Reviewed by parent. Attention: no running harness, fault injection, security-boundary test, or benchmark was performed

decision: Deliver one standalone specification and archive the working drafts
why: One home: builders should not have to reconcile two live contracts

decision: Use a command-only harness with controller-owned repository publication
why: Smallest change: retain controlled publication while keeping the authoring loop minimal

decision: Unify recovery under the continuation and gate authoring by workflow phase
why: Cross-document review found a separate checkpoint pointer and idle active tasks could create inconsistent ownership

decision: Bind the environment, required verification profile, and authority policy to task revisions
why: Review found requirements could otherwise change after acceptance without invalidating pending publication

decision: Pin the base environment and save dependencies under the durable workspace root
why: Review found successful installations outside saved roots could disappear without informing the resumed agent

decision: Order dispatch authorization against revocation and block new publication while paused
why: Review found a gap between authorization and sending the network request

decision: Make verification and integration callbacks conditional and idempotent
why: Review found delayed callbacks could change the phase of newer work
